purpose: Run the ratchet from only F01 and N01 over directed distinction-acts, with no target structure and no preloaded replicator shape.

root_constraints.F01: finite alphabet of tokens (size A) plus bounded active record window (size W); acts beyond W exclude old active acts to append-only graveyard
root_constraints.N01: acts may disturb deterministic finite token states; order genuinely matters in the noncommuting variant

seed_floor: finite append-only record of directed distinction-acts (t,x,y); reflexivity, symmetry, and transitivity are not seed properties
